name: Aioi Moe
source:
A second-year student Sukumi Academy. A laid-back, unmotivated gyaru.

Her results haven't been great lately because she doesn't even try, but when she enrolled she had overwhelming results in long-distance medley events.

She swims because she likes the "pleasant feeling" that envelopes her whole body when she swims at a speed she normally can't, but the feeling disappeared around the second half of her first year. When the pleasure disappeared, she also lost her motivation. She was even thinking about quitting, but now...

Erotic manga is a hobby of hers, and she buys doujinshi. One of her pleasures during training camp is chatting about erotic matters with Shinichi.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.waffle1999.com/game/109himitsu/#character]official site[/url]]
